name: Ashiron Shortsword
description: A reliable shortsword forged from Ashiron steel. Standard issue for Emberheart's city guard.

name: Flame-Hardened Breastplate
description: Leyline-tempered plate armor worn by Flamebound infantry. The metal holds residual warmth.

name: Orichalcum War Axe
description: A heavy war axe forged from golden-red Orichalcum. Favored by House Caldrith's elite knights.

name: Embersteel Plate Armor
description: Full plate armor forged in the Embersteel Quarter's deepest forges. Glows faintly with residual leyline heat. Worn by General Varka's personal guard.

name: Voidsteel Tower Shield
description: A massive tower shield of Voidsteel that absorbs incoming magic. Created for the elite War Golem handlers.

name: Orichalcum War Golem Shell
description: A full golem chassis constructed from Orichalcum plating. This is the outer shell used in House Veydran's production line.

name: Memory-Forged Crown
description: A circlet forged from Memory Ore that enhances the wearer's recall and grants resistance to dream-based attacks. Created by the Memory Smiths of the Forge Academy.

name: Dreamforged Amulet
description: An amulet forged at the intersection of Dream and Memory domains. Allows the wearer to enter light dream-states while awake. Used by Archivist Sybelle's scholars.

name: Godsteel Greatsword
description: A greatsword forged from Godsteel in the Divine Forge of the Vault. Blazes with Echo Flame when drawn. Only three have ever been made — this would be the fourth.

name: Flamekeeper's Regalia
description: Ceremonial and combat armor fit for the God-Ascendant. Forged from every tier of Emberheart metal, it channels Kaelrath's domains of Fire, Memory, Sacrifice, and Dream.
